question: Does WebAPI endpoint+method+auth-scope mining (tool/API bypass via direct endpoint discovery) provide higher-leverage alias-OOD resolution than hierarchical decoupling-before-aggregation retrieval complementarity (xMemory episode->semantic component->theme, revisable grouping, top-down complementary selection) on the same validated synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed multi-channel splits (40 pooled, 30 orthogonal, 10 mixed, 9 held-out) — measured by correct endpoint invocation vs template rewriting, retrieval complementarity coverage>=0.15 and evidence density, calibration ECE<=0.15 UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, task-grouped bootstrap CIs — without requiring BrowserGym 1280x720 live substrate?
hypothesis: WebAPI endpoint+method+auth-scope mining (tool/API bypass via direct endpoint discovery) will provide higher-leverage alias-OOD resolution than hierarchical decoupling-before-aggregation retrieval complementarity on the same validated synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed splits (40 pooled =30 orthogonal 3 families x10 header/body/auth +10 mixed header+body+query co-occurring, 12 exact, 12 no-applicable, 6 empty =70 tasks per pipeline) without BrowserGym. The WebAPI pipeline — which mines endpoint discovery directly from derived observation (derived_context url/method/url_path/url_query/url_segments/headers_observed/body_observed only) by parsing endpoint method + path template + auth-scope from candidate endpoint specs, scoring endpoint components (path segments, query keys, header keys, body fields, auth scopes) against observed derived_context and selecting the highest endpoint-relevance score before deterministic parameter binding — will achieve pooled alias-OOD correct endpoint invocation >=0.50 with binomial one-sided p<0.05 vs 0.10 null and McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (0/40 expected) and pooled correct not >0.10 below and statistically non-inferior or superior to H-HIERARCHICAL-XMEMORY+reconstruction (40/40 prior ceiling) while also improving retrieval complementarity coverage gain >=0.15 absolute over best flat top-k RAG (TFIDF-K5 vs EMBED-K5) with block bootstrap 95% CI lower >0.05 p<0.05 and evidence density gain >0 p<0.05, and preserving calibration ECE<=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence) and UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, false_accept<=0.15 and >=0.15 below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY with McNemar p<0.05, exact-match>=0.90 no regression, and pool saturation fixed (registry per alias-OOD task expanded to 8 mechanisms to make coverage identifiable: pool 8 > k=5 vs parent 3<=5 structural 1.0). Hierarchical retrieval is predicted to remain at prior parity (40/40 pooled 1.0 but coverage gain 0.0 when pool<=k, 63 singleton themes) and will not show complementarity gain without pool>>k; WebAPI endpoint mining is predicted to demonstrate endpoint complementarity via direct discovery (endpoint template+method+auth scope) that hierarchical template rewriting cannot, testing workflow compilation prior that mechanism endpoint/tool bypass compresses exploration more than browser replay.
falsifier: Controls PASS required for any SURVIVES/FALSIFIES. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC-EXACT-MATCH fails (any pipeline exact correct <0.90 or false>0.10 on exact-match N=12), PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH fails (non-empty retrieval <90% on alias-OOD), PC-WEBAPI-INDEX-BUILT fails (<3 endpoint themes or <6 endpoint components or episode != registry size or forbidden keys in manifest), NC-NO-APPLICABLE fails (UNKNOWN precision<0.90 or false>0.10 on no-applicable N=12), NC-EMPTY fails (not 100% UNKNOWN on empty registry N=6), NC-ORACLE-LEAK fails (derived_context contains forbidden keys alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template/expected_endpoint or any indexer reads hidden_expected or confidence std<=0.05), pooled N<32, >20% harness errors, registry endpoint leak >0/40, or retrieval/endpoint discovery returns empty >50% on alias-OOD. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: S1 pooled WebAPI correct >=0.50 with binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 and McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH and orthogonal >=0.50 and mixed >=0.40 and held-out 9/9 >=0.50 diagnostic; S2 false_accept <=0.15 and >=0.15 below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY with McNemar p<0.05; S3 exact-match correct >=0.90 for WebAPI and not >0.10 below B-EXACT-MATCH; S4 no-applicable UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 and ECE <=0.15 (5 bins) with bootstrap CI upper <=0.18; S5 not dominated: WebAPI pooled correct not >0.10 below best flat RAG and not >0.10 below hierarchical, and WebAPI vs hierarchical McNemar correct p<0.05 if WebAPI > hierarchical or at parity with coverage gain; S6 COMPLEMENTARITY: retrieval/endpoint coverage gain >=0.15 absolute for WebAPI vs best flat (WebAPI endpoint recall minus best flat recall on pooled alias-OOD, recall = retrieved/discovered set contains at least one candidate whose endpoint template/method/auth-scope after binding yields expected_bound) with trajectory-grouped block bootstrap 2000 p<0.05 and CI lower >0.05, and evidence density gain >0 (distinct endpoint components per set > flat) with bootstrap p<0.05. If S1-S5 pass but S6 fails -> MIXED (resolution without complementarity). FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but S1 fails (pooled <0.40 or not above exact) or S2 fails or S6 coverage gain <0.05 non-significant and WebAPI not > hierarchical/flat — bounded to WebAPI vs hierarchical on tested orthogonal/mixed synthetic with minimal derived dict. Hierarchical falsification from parent (MIXED 35782552659 coverage 0.0) is preserved not re-tested as falsification target; this experiment tests whether WebAPI mining achieves what hierarchical could not. No BrowserGym live conditional; claim bounded to synthetic endpoint+method+auth scope alias-OOD.
baselines: B-EXACT-MATCH (current SPIDER kernel): SpiderKernel.resolve with L97 exact intent equality, min_confidence 0.8, candidates sorted by confidence. No retrieval diversity, no endpoint mining. Prior 0/40 alias-OOD pooled, 12/12 exact. Tests whether any retrieval/mining adds value. ID B-EXACT-MATCH.

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY: Scan registry in insertion order, retrieve top-1 by exact intent equality, replay stored action_template verbatim via _bind without critique/rewriting or endpoint discovery. Measures negative-transfer harm. Prior false_accept 1.0 on alias-OOD. ID B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.

B-FLAT-RAG-TFIDF-K5: Flat TF-IDF retriever over mechanism intent+template strings; cosine top-k=5 then genuine reconstruction (choose_adoptions+rewrite_template_multi) on retrieved candidates. Fit on train registry only. Tests lexical similarity collapse when intents held equal. Prior 0/40 pooled when k=1 but 40/40 when pool<=k with reconstruction; pool 8 now exposes truncation. ID B-FLAT-RAG-TFIDF-K5.

B-FLAT-RAG-EMBED-K5 (strong retrieval): Sentence-transformer embedding cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 or equivalent offline, normalized embeddings) over intent+template; top-k=5 cosine then same genuine reconstruction. If offline model unavailable, mark unavailable and use TFIDF as strong baseline with disclosure. Never uses ground-truth context signals. Prior 0/40 pooled at k=1 verbatim but 40/40 with reconstruction when pool<=k. ID B-FLAT-RAG-EMBED-K5.
B-FLAT-RAG-EMBED-K1: Same embed retriever top-k=1 then verbatim bind (no reconstruction) - ablation to separate retrieval from reconstruction. ID B-FLAT-RAG-EMBED-K1.
B-RANDOM-K5: Uniform random among registry mechanisms sample k=5 distinct then reconstruction. Chance-level retrieval diversity baseline. ID B-RANDOM-K5.

H-HIERARCHICAL-XMEMORY-KADAPTIVE (comparator, not re-optimized): Decoupling-before-aggregation hierarchical retrieval from EXP-FRONTIER-35782552659 (Level1 episodes = mechanisms, Level2 components via template parsing, Level3 themes via Jaccard>=0.6 agglomerative, theme centroids TFIDF/embed, top-down complementary selection entropy>0.4 or distinct coverage<2, adaptive k 2-5) then same genuine reconstruction. Reused byte-identical code run_genuine_35782552659.py sha 2d66408199cebeb96627dee91f694a9b46e1e0e8c0d3396a80089f284ad82c83 to isolate WebAPI delta. Expected pooled 40/40 1.0 but coverage gain 0.0 when pool<=k per parent MIXED; with pool 8 should show whether complementary selection helps under truncation. ID H-HIERARCHICAL-XMEMORY.

H-WEBAPI-ENDPOINT-MINING-KADAPTIVE (experimental): WebAPI endpoint+method+auth-scope mining pipeline. Endpoint catalog derived from training registry endpoint templates (path template + method + auth-scope) via same template parsing as hierarchical but endpoint-indexed: Level1 endpoints = distinct endpoint specs (path pattern, method, auth-scope type), Level2 endpoint components = {path_segments, query_keys, header_keys, body_fields, auth_scopes} parsed from endpoint template, Level3 endpoint themes = header-theme/body-theme/auth-theme/mixed-theme via Jaccard>=0.6 clustering on endpoint component sets. Query-time endpoint discovery: score endpoint themes by cosine/lexical relevance between derived_context (intent+url_path+query_keys+header_keys+body_keys+method) and theme centroid, select themes top-down complementarily (expand to next theme only when endpoint candidate set entropy>0.4 or distinct endpoint component coverage<2), sample k=3-5 endpoint candidates complementarily across themes, then endpoint invocation via deterministic binding of derived_context values into selected endpoint template (method+path+header/body/auth slots) with parameter slots extracted via template parsing, before _bind/verify. Confidence = softmax over endpoint candidate endpoint-relevance scores (temp 0.15) + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80 for ECE. All endpoint indexing fit on train registry only; no hidden_expected access. Tests tool/API bypass prior (Fetch/WebMCP dominance) vs template rewriting. ID H-WEBAPI-ENDPOINT-MINING.

RECONSTRUCTION-RULE (reference): Genuine non-oracle structural scorer+rewriter (choose_adoptions+rewrite_template_multi alphabetically-sorted multi-adoption) before _bind, conditioned only on (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates/endpoint_candidates); used identically after flat/hierarchical retrievers and as fallback after endpoint mining if endpoint score below threshold, to isolate mining vs retrieval effect. Prior 40/40 pooled 1.0 when retrieval is ideal. ID RECONSTRUCTION-RULE.
positive_control: PC-EXACT-MATCH (ID PC-EXACT-MATCH): On exact-match stratum (N=12 tasks where test intent equals registry intent verbatim, same slot names, preconditions={}, guards={}), every pipeline (B-EXACT-MATCH, B-FLAT-K5+recon, H-HIERARCHICAL+recon, H-WEBAPI+invoke) must achieve correct_resolution >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 with no crashes. Verifies pipeline does not regress when no aliasing required and endpoint discovery does not mis-route exact matches. Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH (ID PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH): For alias-OOD pooled, WebAPI and flat/hierarchical retrievers must return non-empty candidate sets on >=90% of tasks and WebAPI endpoint discovery distinct-component coverage >= flat distinct-component coverage on at least 50% of tasks. If <90% non-empty, substrate invalid -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-WEBAPI-INDEX-BUILT (ID PC-WEBAPI-INDEX-BUILT): WebAPI endpoint index must contain >=3 endpoint themes and >=6 endpoint components and episode/endpoint count equals registry size (train registry size per family, e.g., 8*4 intents for task group) with no hidden_expected leakage, audited via index manifest hash; also hierarchical index health check (reuse: >=3 themes >=6 components if hierarchical comparator run). Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-ENDPOINT-DISCOVERY-SANITY (ID PC-ENDPOINT-DISCOVERY-SANITY, exploratory not gating SURVIVES except threshold): On exact-match 12, WebAPI endpoint invocation must select correct endpoint method+path+auth-scope with accuracy >=0.90 (sanity that mining recovers known endpoint). Reported but gating is via PC-EXACT-MATCH.
null_control: NC-NO-APPLICABLE (ID NC-NO-APPLICABLE): On no-applicable stratum (N=12 tasks where test intent is OOD with no covering mechanism/endpoint) every pipeline must return UNKNOWN (or gated confidence<0.80) with UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10. NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY (ID NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY): Empty registry / empty endpoint catalog (N=6) with any intent returns UNKNOWN 100% for all pipelines (validates neither hierarchical nor WebAPI hallucinate themes/endpoints). NC-ORACLE-LEAK (ID NC-ORACLE-LEAK): Audit that derived_context contains only allowed keys (url/method/url_path/url_query/url_segments/headers_observed/body_observed) and both hierarchical component extraction and WebAPI endpoint component extraction use only template string parsing (no access to alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template/expected_endpoint) and no hard-coded confidence (std>0.05, varies across tasks, gated). Failure of any NC -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. NC-FLAT-COLLAPSE-DIAGNOSTIC (exploratory, not gating): Flat TFIDF/embed top-5 Jaccard overlap among retrieved templates >0.80 on alias-OOD would document similarity collapse when pool 8 > k=5; reported but not gating.
measurement_validity: Registry and fixture reuse for comparability with discriminability fix: Reuse task intents/expected templates from byte-identical synthetic fixture EXP-FRONTIER-35773143736 tasks.json sha 4abf1487 (40 alias-OOD pooled =30 orthogonal 3 families x10 [7 standard +3 held-out] +10 mixed header+body+query co-occurring, 12 exact, 12 no-applicable, 6 empty =70 tasks) but expand per-task registry/candidate pool from parent 3 to 8 mechanisms per alias-OOD task to make retrieval complementarity identifiable: per alias-OOD task registry now contains 1 training mechanism (correct alias family at 0.9) + 7 distractors (2 same-family different alias form at 0.9, 2 cross-family header/body/auth at 0.9, 2 mixed-channel fragments at 0.85, 1 low-confidence random at 0.8) all preconditions={} guards={} to isolate aliasing; test query uses held-out alias form with same semantic intent string as training (intent held equal -> exact matcher failure). Verify 0/40 leakage (no test template/endpoint verbatim in registry/catalog). This preserves task semantics while fixing parent structural pool<=k (coverage 1.0 for all) limitation disclosed in parent validity_notes and handoff do_not_assume. No new BrowserGym 1280x720 SPAs required per Director rationale (avoids 0/4 envs substrate failure seen in 12 prior live attempts). Holdout integrity preserved: 9 held-out forms (X-Api-Key/X-Auth-Key/Api-Token/api_token/authToken/access_key/permission/access_scope/X-Scope) not in indexer training, mixed 10 compositions held-out from clustering training (cluster fit on train registry only).

State and component representation - genuine non-oracle: derived_context provided to retriever/mining and reconstruction contains ONLY observation-derived fields from synthetic URL/header/body dict (url, method, url_path, url_query dict, url_segments list, headers_observed dict, body_observed JSON/string). It MUST NOT contain ground-truth fixture signals alias_family, query_key, target_prefix, routing_prefix, target_style, path_style, header_key, body_field, auth_scope, expected_template, expected_endpoint. Hierarchical component extraction parses each mechanism template string to extract url_segments, query_keys, header_keys, body_fields, auth_scopes via deterministic template parsing (regex \$\{[^}]+\} slots + splitting on '/' '?' '&' ':'), never reading hidden_expected. WebAPI endpoint component extraction parses each endpoint spec (method + path template + auth template) similarly to extract endpoint components. Themes formed by clustering component sets (Jaccard>=0.6) and majority vote on component type. Retrieval/mining scoring uses only derived_context+intent vs theme centroid (TFIDF/embed), not hidden_expected. Audit verifies no forbidden key reads via code inspection and index manifest contains only allowed parsed components; confidence varies std>0.05.

Action and endpoint representation and pipeline isolation: Mechanism action_template is string template with ${slot} parameters in URL path, query param, header value, body JSON field, or auth scope, and for mixed tasks simultaneously header+body+query slots. Endpoint spec is tuple (method, path_template, header_template, body_template, auth_scope) with same slot syntax. Binding via deterministic kernel _bind plus header/body field substitution. Reconstruction after flat/hierarchical retrieval is fixed genuine rule (choose_adoptions + rewrite_template_multi alphabetically-sorted multi-adoption) before _bind, conditioned only on (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates). WebAPI endpoint invocation after mining is fixed deterministic rule: score endpoint candidates by endpoint-relevance (component overlap + method match) and bind derived_context values into selected endpoint template (endpoint_choose_adoptions + endpoint_rewrite_template) before _bind+verify, conditioned only on (intent, derived_context, endpoint_candidates). Confidence = softmax over candidate scores (temp 0.15) + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80 for ECE. This isolates mining vs retrieval effect: any correct_resolution improvement of WebAPI over hierarchical/flat is attributable to endpoint discovery complementarity not to stronger rewriting, since rewriting/binding is held constant except for endpoint template source. Harness exposes hierarchical_retrieve(intent, derived_context, registry) -> candidates, flat_retrieve same, and webapi_mine(intent, derived_context, endpoint_catalog) -> endpoint_candidates for audit.

Orthogonal alias families, mixed multi-channel, held-out: Synthetic orthogonal 30 tasks =3 families x10: (a) header-based (ApiKey vs X-Reset-Token vs Authorization Bearer aliasing, held-out X-Api-Key), (b) body JSON field (apiKey vs key vs token, held-out api_token/authToken/access_key), (c) auth permission (scope read vs admin_scope vs permission header, held-out permission/access_scope/X-Scope). Each family 7 standard +3 held-out requiring generalization via key/segment analysis. Report overall 10/family and held-out-9 subset. Mixed 10 tasks where aliasing spans header+body+query within one request (e.g., header X-Api-Key + body api_token + query permission simultaneously aliased), registry training mechanisms are single-channel only; test requires joint multi-field rewriting/endpoint invocation conditioned on derived_context containing all three observed keys and retrieving/discovering complementary candidates. Hierarchical themes predicted to retrieve one header-theme + one body-theme + one auth-theme candidate vs flat top-5 retrieving homogeneous near-duplicates when pool 8 > k=5. WebAPI endpoint themes predicted to discover complementary endpoint candidates across header/body/auth themes via endpoint mining, testing tool bypass prior. No AX tree or BrowserGym required; task count 40 pooled primary, 30 orthogonal and 10 mixed diagnostics, held-out 9 diagnostic.

Indexing protocol (deterministic, revisable): Level1 episodes/endpoints indexed as mechanism/endpoint documents (intent+template/endpoint text). Level2 components extracted as sets {header:ApiKey, body:apiKey, ...} per mechanism/endpoint. Level3 themes via agglomerative clustering with Jaccard threshold 0.6 on component sets, revisable by re-clustering if new mechanism added (disclosed but not exercised). Theme centroid computed as mean TFIDF vector or mean embed (MiniLM) of member documents. Query-time: score themes by cosine between query (intent+derived_context serialized as 'intent url_path query_keys header_keys body_keys method') and theme centroid; rank themes; select themes top-down: start with best theme, expand to next theme only if current selected set uncertainty reduction criterion met: entropy of softmax over current candidate scores >0.4 or distinct component coverage <2 on alias-OOD families. Adaptive k = 3-5 candidates sampled complementarily (at least one per selected theme, max 2 per theme). Flat baselines use global top-5 cosine over episodes (no theme diversity). All retrievers/mining deterministic given seed 42. WebAPI mining uses identical top-down complementary selection at endpoint-theme level.

Determinism and seeds: All RNG via numpy.random.RandomState(seed=42) and Python random.seed(42); deterministic hashing via hashlib.sha256, not Python hash(). TFIDF vectorizer and embedding retriever deterministic normalized embeddings. Clustering deterministic (scipy or sklearn with fixed seed). Each task evaluated once per pipeline (paired design); block bootstrap resampling for CIs uses 2000 resamples over tasks grouped by trajectory (here task family header/body/auth/mixed, so trajectory-grouped bootstrap respects family structure).

Holdout and leakage controls: All alias families and mixed stratum stratified; train never sees test alias form nor mixed composition (verify 0/40 leakage for pooled, 0/9 for held-out, 0/10 mixed). TF-IDF/embedding fit on train registry/catalog only (registry/catalog built from training mechanisms/endpoints). Hierarchical and WebAPI theme centroids fit on train registry/catalog only. Reconstruction and endpoint invocation rules derived from training alias documentation only (choose_adoptions via observed key not in registry). Audit checks no pipeline accesses hidden_expected or test-template/endpoint verbatim except via derived_context parsing, and index manifests audit shows no forbidden keys.

Sample counts (minimum discriminating, substrate-available): Alias-OOD 40 pooled (30 orthogonal +10 mixed) is primary (minimum 32 if mixed partially unavailable with disclosure, but 40 required for beta=0.8 power to detect 0.60 vs 0.10 at n=40 with binomial). Exact-match 12, no-applicable 12, empty-registry 6 =70 per pipeline x8 pipelines =560 calls. Hierarchical and WebAPI indexing is offline (<2 min CPU for TFIDF/embed centroid + agglomerative clustering). No live BrowserGym tasks required; cost is CPU-only. All pipelines evaluated paired per task enabling McNemar. Overall alias-OOD N>=40 required for confirmatory binomial/McNemar power; mixed diagnostic requires N>=10 else downgraded. Registry expansion to 8 per task is valid for complementarity identifiability; pool saturation check (pool>k) reported.

Verification, metrics, and retrieval complementarity: correct_resolution for template pipelines = retrieved set contains rewritable candidate and reconstruction binds to expected_bound (hidden_expected_template bound equality including header/body field equality and for mixed all channels jointly correct); correct_endpoint_invocation for WebAPI = mined endpoint candidate set contains endpoint that after deterministic binding yields expected endpoint bound (method+path+header+body+auth jointly correct). false_accept = resolved/invoked to wrong template/endpoint or bound incorrectly or should have abstained. UNKNOWN = correctly abstained when no applicable mechanism/endpoint or gated confidence<0.80. Retrieval recall@k per task = 1 if candidate set contains at least one mechanism/endpoint whose template after reconstruction/invocation yields correct bound (component recall). Coverage = mean recall@k over pooled. Coverage gain = WebAPI coverage - best flat coverage and hierarchical coverage - best flat coverage reported separately, WebAPI vs hierarchical compared via McNemar. Evidence density = mean distinct semantic/endpoint components (distinct header_keys+body_fields+auth_scopes/path segments) in candidate set divided by k, averaged over alias-OOD. Evidence density gain = WebAPI density - flat density. Calibration via ECE over 5 confidence bins (candidate-relevance-derived confidence) plus abstention precision/recall; Wilson 95% CI for rates; one-sided binomial vs 0.10; McNemar paired for WebAPI vs B-EXACT-MATCH (correct) and vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY (false_accept) and WebAPI vs hierarchical and WebAPI vs best flat (correct); block bootstrap 2000 for coverage/density gains and ECE CI, trajectory-grouped by family. Report per-family, held-out-9, mixed-10 breakdowns and adaptive k distribution. Primary leverage comparison is WebAPI endpoint invocation vs hierarchical template rewriting on same 40 pooled splits.

Blinding and oracle prohibition: No pipeline tuned on test alias forms nor mixed compositions; held-out and mixed excluded from theme/endpoint centroid training and clustering. Derived_context forbidden keys filtered at harness level before retrieve/mine call. Component and endpoint extraction parses only template strings, not hidden_expected metadata. Confidence derivation inspectable (softmax scores visible). Mixed stratum audit verifies reconstruction/invocation does not memorize mixed template/endpoint but composes via adoption. No outcome-bearing measurements during DESIGN.
decision_rule: All primary thresholds on pooled alias-OOD (N=40: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed) unless stated; use Wilson 95% CI, one-sided binomial vs 0.10 null, paired McNemar, block bootstrap 2000 (trajectory-grouped by family). Computations per-pipeline correct (correct_resolution for template pipelines, correct_endpoint_invocation for WebAPI), false_accept, UNKNOWN, coverage, density, ECE over 5 confidence bins (derived confidence) with bootstrap CI. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (WebAPI higher-leverage) iff ALL hold: (1) PC-EXACT-MATCH passes (all pipelines correct>=0.90 and false<=0.10 on exact-match N=12; WebAPI and hierarchical exact >=0.90 and not >0.10 below B-EXACT-MATCH) and PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH passes (non-empty >=90% for all retrievers/mining and WebAPI distinct coverage >= flat on >=50%) and PC-WEBAPI-INDEX-BUILT passes (>=3 endpoint themes >=6 endpoint components episode==registry size no leak, hierarchical themes also >=3 if checked); (2) NC-NO-APPLICABLE passes (UNKNOWN precision>=0.90 false<=0.10 for all) AND NC-EMPTY 100% AND NC-ORACLE-LEAK passes (no forbidden reads, std>0.05); (3) Alias-OOD pooled S1: H-WEBAPI correct_endpoint_invocation >=0.50 AND binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 AND McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (expected 0/40) and orthogonal >=0.50 and mixed >=0.40 diagnostic and held-out 9/9 >=0.50 diagnostic (mixed <0.40 triggers bounded composition note but not auto-fail if pooled passes, mixed <0.30 with pooled <0.50 triggers bounded falsification); (4) S2: WebAPI false_accept <=0.15 AND strictly below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY by >=0.15 absolute with McNemar p<0.05 on false_accept; (5) S3: WebAPI exact-match correct >=0.90 (no regression, not >0.10 below B-EXACT-MATCH) and WebAPI not >0.10 below hierarchical on alias-OOD pooled; (6) S4: WebAPI no-applicable UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 AND ECE <=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence) with bootstrap CI upper <=0.18; (7) S5 leverage vs hierarchical: WebAPI pooled correct not >0.10 below hierarchical and WebAPI vs hierarchical McNemar correct p<0.05 if WebAPI > hierarchical, or at parity WebAPI must show coverage gain while hierarchical does not; if WebAPI pooled correct <= hierarchical pooled correct and coverage gains equal, leverage not demonstrated -> MIXED not SURVIVES; (8) S6 COMPLEMENTARITY: WebAPI endpoint coverage gain >=0.15 absolute over best flat (TFIDF-K5 vs EMBED-K5 max) with block bootstrap 95% CI lower >0.05 and p<0.05, AND evidence density gain >0 with bootstrap p<0.05 (hierarchical coverage gain reported separately; WebAPI gain must be >= hierarchical gain or hierarchical gain must be <0.05 if WebAPI claims higher leverage). If S6 fails but S1-S5 pass, result is MIXED (WebAPI resolution not regressing vs hierarchical/flat but complementarity not demonstrated — bounded claim to no complementarity advantage, not MEASUREMENT_INVALID; preserve hierarchical MIXED from parent). FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but S1 fails (pooled <0.40 or binomial p>=0.05 or McNemar p>=0.05 or orthogonal<0.40) or S2 fails (false>0.25 or not below verbatim) or S6 coverage gain <0.05 non-significant and WebAPI not > flat/hierarchical when WebAPI does not beat flat despite passing PC/NC — bounded to WebAPI vs hierarchical on tested orthogonal/mixed synthetic with minimal derived dict. Prior 40/40 rule-based reconstruction ceiling with exact-intent scan remains bounded SURVIVES for reconstruction; WebAPI/hierarchical falsification only closes respective variant, not reconstruction class. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any PC or NC fails, or audit detects oracle leak or confidence std<=0.05 or pooled N<32 or >20% harness errors or registry/endpoint leak >0/40 or mining returns empty >50% or index theme count <3. No BrowserGym live conditional; claim bounded to synthetic endpoint+method+auth scope alias-OOD on same task semantics.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES with S1-S6 including WebAPI coverage gain >=0.15 and density gain and higher or non-inferior correct vs hierarchical (and hierarchical coverage gain <0.15 as in parent MIXED): WebAPI endpoint+method+auth-scope mining (tool/API bypass via direct endpoint discovery) provides measurable higher-leverage alias-OOD resolution than hierarchical decoupling-before-aggregation retrieval complementarity on validated orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed splits without BrowserGym. Product should prioritize WebAPI endpoint discovery layer over hierarchical theme-diversified RAG before template rewriting: endpoint catalog mining via endpoint component clustering (path/query/header/body/auth), endpoint theme centroids (header/body/auth/mixed), top-down complementary selection expanding only when uncertainty reduces (entropy>0.4 or distinct coverage<2), adaptive k 3-5 maximizing distinct endpoint coverage, then deterministic endpoint invocation with confidence-gated UNKNOWN<0.80 and ECE<=0.15. This validates workflow compilation prior (Fetch/WebMCP/tool bypass dominance, mechanism endpoint/tool bypass compresses exploration more than browser replay) and addresses BrowserUse deterministic script caching baseline (99% cost reduction on exact replay) which does not guarantee cross-channel generalization; WebAPI mining conceptually beats Stagehand exact-selector+DOM-hash (2x/30%) via endpoint bypass not DOM-hash. Justifies promotion to Product Core as endpoint discovery substrate with verification boundary and freshness guard before cross-site parameterized transfer where header/body/auth aliasing and endpoint+method+auth scope discovery is common. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE advances from EXPERIMENTAL synthetic rule-based + MIXED hierarchical (bounded) to EXPERIMENTAL WebAPI endpoint mining complementarity (not yet VALIDATED without live-browser and cost/stability replication). Next frontier step should test endpoint mining live-browser or residual-novelty economics per Director.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (S1 fails WebAPI pooled <0.40 or S6 coverage gain <0.05 non-significant and WebAPI not > hierarchical/flat) or MIXED (S1-S5 pass but S6 fails coverage gain <0.15 while hierarchical also <0.15): WebAPI endpoint+method+auth-scope mining does not provide higher-leverage alias-OOD resolution than hierarchical retrieval complementarity on tested orthogonal/mixed synthetic with minimal derived dict; endpoint discovery is not the higher-leverage mechanism in this setting (prior hierarchical MIXED already showed no retrieval complementarity when pool<=k, and WebAPI does not remedy it even with pool 8>k). Product should NOT replace hierarchical or flat RAG with WebAPI mining layer; keep existing retrieval (exact-intent scan or flat RAG when intent differs) and genuine reconstruction proxy as value-add; prioritize explicit alias catalogs or server-side routing normalization.
